jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This full-time Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with a hybrid work arrangement that combines office presence and work-from-home flexibility. The role involves monitoring transactions and account activity to identify potential fraud or financial crime patterns, using data analysis and risk assessment tools. The analyst will review alerts, investigate suspicious activities, document findings, and prepare clear reports and recommendations for management and relevant stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with compliance, operations, and finance teams, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements and typologies, and contributing to the enhancement of fraud detection rules and controls. The role also requires supporting the development of policies, procedures, and training materials to improve the organization’s overall fraud and financial crime prevention framework.
Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and risk analysis capabilities, with experience interpreting complex data to identify potential fraud or financial crime.
Solid foundation in finance and statistics, enabling effective assessment of financial transactions and quantitative risk indicators.
Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to produce concise reports and explain findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Relevant experience in fraud risk management, financial crime, compliance, or related fields within banking, fintech, or consulting.
Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, sanctions screening, and fraud detection tools or case management systems.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics, business, law, or a related discipline; professional certifications (e.g., CAMS, CFE) are an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment, manage priorities independently, and collaborate within cross-functional, multicultural teams.
High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining confidentiality and regulatory compliance.

jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst role at CMA Formation Centre-Val de Loire is a part-time hybrid position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with flexibility for some work from home. The role involves monitoring transactions and customer activities to identify potential fraud, money laundering, and other financial crimes. The analyst will conduct risk assessments, investigate alerts and suspicious activities, document findings, and prepare clear reports and recommendations. This position also includes collaborating with internal teams and external partners, supporting the implementation of controls and mitigation strategies, and staying up to date with regulatory requirements and emerging financial crime trends.
Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and proven ability to interpret complex data sets and patterns.
Experience in risk analysis and familiarity with financial crime risk assessment frameworks.
Knowledge of finance concepts relevant to fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and compliance.
Effective communication skills, including the ability to present findings and write clear reports.
Understanding of statistics and ability to use statistical methods or tools to support risk analysis.
Experience in fraud investigation, AML/CTF, or financial crime compliance is highly beneficial.
Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, manage priorities, and maintain confidentiality.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics, business, law, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CAMS, CFE) are an advantage.
